mechanisms.name: V27 performs blanket experience-custody retirement alongside topology removal
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: Commit33163727 adds retire_background_authorized_development. It removes non-source cells at layers9/10/11/13, releases their places and removes incident contacts. For every surviving cohort it sets pending_experience, retained_experience and pending_recurrence to None. It clears all three active frontiers, the complete mosaics collection and hippocampal index. has_cognitive_custody can trigger this clearing even when the retired-lineage set is empty. Generation and next-lineage ordinal survive.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: The exact source confirms broader custody clearing than merely deleting graph edges. It does not prove that every cleared experience in preserved sensory/body cohorts depended on invalid contacts. It preserves those cohorts’ physical state values, so “all neuronal learning was erased” would also exceed this evidence. Historical report/source evidence does not establish current activation.
mechanisms.replacement: Bind the disclosed, authorized topology cleanup to an exact per-owner preservation/loss account. Separate preserved physical plastic state from removed experience/formation/recall custody and resulting lost capabilities. Recover usable causative history only through an authorized direct physical mapping, never invented memories or current-state reset.

acceptance.release: No preservation certificate from UUID/generation/format validity; disclose every sanctioned loss and independently qualify retained effects on the exact release.

mechanisms.name: Outer current-envelope guard limits the migration’s actual reach
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: The historical outer migrate_resident_organism_exact_energy_envelope returns the original bytes when the cognitive segment has the current marker, current decode succeeds, and both vestibular and articulated body state are present. Otherwise it calls the cognitive migration, supplies genesis/neutral body state where absent, re-encodes and checks identity, organism tick and fabric generation. V27 deliberately retains the V26 payload layout while changing format identity for the authority boundary.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: This is concrete counterevidence to a blanket claim that every restart clears memory. The three post-migration identity checks do not test preservation of formations or learned behavior. Format validity and a migration-gate claim are distinct from per-state historical authenticity. Actual startup/deployment configuration and original envelope execution are not independently replayed here.
mechanisms.replacement: Preserve the valid-current no-op guard and qualify every actual external migration/restore entry. Versioned body commissioning must be explicit and authorized, with exact missing/preserved-state accounting. No ordinary recovery may quietly choose a destructive repair for unrecognized state.

acceptance.unit: Verify valid learned current envelopes return byte-identically and invalid/legacy inputs take only their authorized explicit paths.
acceptance.module: Trace wrapper, native entry, decode, body initialization and final publication using exact artifacts and configuration.
acceptance.system: Demonstrate learned-state persistence across cold restart and repeated deployment without rerunning retirement.
acceptance.release: Bind format/source/migration identity and actual serving entry; do not certify preservation from the three identity counters alone.

mechanisms.name: Artifact-dependent migration tests can pass without testing the artifact
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: MG04 contains six #[test] functions that return immediately when their required GUALA_* artifact paths are absent; MG02 registers the module under cfg(test). real_production_body_migrates_losslessly also expects NoncanonicalState from ordinary decoding of retired energy bytes, while this commit’s ordinary decode first returns RetiredCognitiveState for any non-V27 marker. Its32MB fixture allowance and old omitted-material/mosaic-equality assertions do not qualify the documented113MB destructive migration.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: No test ran in this audit. Missing environment yields a successful no-op path in source; whether a particular historical suite set those variables is not established. The documented472-pass suite cannot by itself prove these artifact assertions ran. The synthetic MAX_BYTES1.6billion constant is a byte budget, not evidence of an energy multiplier; quantities must be classified by units and consumer.
mechanisms.replacement: Make missing required artifacts explicit unavailable/ignored-with-reason or failing gates, with separate executed-capability accounting. Replace stale assertions only through a ratified preservation/loss contract and exact source/candidate fixture. Preserve the original failed predicate and loss evidence; never soften a test to hide unsupported retirement.

acceptance.unit: Missing/corrupt/wrong-version artifacts must not report a qualified capability pass; verify actual assertion execution.
acceptance.module: Bind source, rebuilt native artifact, required envelope/world and exact configuration to each migration proof.
acceptance.system: Require complete preserved-state or explicitly authorized-loss behavior and real post-restore causal use, not suite totals.
acceptance.release: Release receipts must distinguish executed/pass/fail/ignored/unavailable and cannot turn a no-op fixture into lossless-migration evidence.

mechanisms.name: Retinal diagnostic probes are narrower than acquired language
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: The historical test module reports retinal state/delta/capacity and asserts that A and K leave at least one distinct retained delta. Another diagnostic constructs an abstract contact coordinate1+abs(gate-population fraction difference), runs a compatibility plastic-support calculation and prints counts of changed/refused results; it does not assert successful recurrence or learned behavior. The underlying snapshot decode and input identity are still required.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: These are test/probe computations, not demonstrated active cognitive controllers. Distinct retained retinal states are potentially useful component evidence but do not establish recognition, meaningful words, speech, syntax or lawful actual contact evolution. No probe was executed here and no current serving use is inferred.
mechanisms.replacement: Classify each probe as diagnostic observation, component predicate or actual behavioral acceptance. Derive physical coordinates/units from authorized source laws if used for qualification; require actual native contact/formation lineage and later causal use rather than a compatibility-coordinate prediction.

acceptance.unit: Verify measurement identity, coordinate units and exact predicates; printed counts are not assertions of capability.
acceptance.module: Bind retained native changes and actual physical contact effects to authentic sensory occurrences.
acceptance.system: Test later contextual recognition/action/articulation independently of mere A/K state separation, with matched negative controls.
acceptance.release: Speech/language claims require exact release and causal/intelligibility evidence; do not promote diagnostic proxy output into native success.
